adjudication.rationale: In `Jobs::PollFeed#execute`, `poll_feed` runs only if `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled? && SiteSetting.feed_polling_url.present? && SiteSetting.embed_by_username.present?` (added in this diff). In `spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb`, the example `it "requires embed_by_username"` stubs only `embed_by_username` to `nil` and then expects `poll_feed` to never run, but it does not stub `feed_polling_enabled?` or `feed_polling_url`. Since the new site settings default `feed_polling_enabled: false` and `feed_polling_url: ''` in `config/site_settings.yml`, this spec will pass even if the `embed_by_username.present?` guard is removed, making it a vacuous/duplicate test rather than validating the new condition.
